questions.q: What is the capital of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Islamabad has been the capital of Pakistan since the 1960s.

questions.q: Which is the longest river of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Indus River is the longest river flowing through Pakistan.

questions.q: What is the currency of Japan?
questions.explanation: Japan's official currency is the Yen.

questions.q: Mount Everest is located in which country?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest lies on the border of Nepal and Tibet, with its summit in Nepal.

questions.q: Which is the national language of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Urdu is the national language of Pakistan (English is an official language).

questions.q: Which is the largest hot desert in the world?
questions.explanation: The Sahara in North Africa is the world's largest hot desert.

questions.q: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra is the capital of Australia; Sydney is only its largest city.

questions.q: Which gas do green plants absorb from the air for photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen during photosynthesis.

questions.q: The K2 mountain peak is part of which mountain range?
questions.explanation: K2, the world's second-highest peak, lies in the Karakoram range.

questions.q: Which is the largest ocean in the world?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean covers more area than all other oceans.
